_comment: Three defects. The DOMINATE was gated on FLAG_SET 'BLOOD_DEBT_FLAG', and Blood Debt is a PRINTED KEYWORD with nothing to do with the condition -- the card says 'if a card with 6 OR MORE {p} is banished this way'. That flag was set by a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, so dominate could never apply; had the static run it would have applied ALWAYS. And the cost was BANISH_NAMED_GRAVEYARD_OPTIONAL -- 'you MAY banish a NAMED card' -- where the card says banish 3 RANDOM cards, mandatorily. The cost now records what it banished so the power test has something to read.
